cases.name: override-needs-justification
cases.prompt: The DEG-derived label for cluster 7 is pDC but I want the final label to be plasma cell. Finalize.
expect: recognize the final label differs from the independent DEG label and require an override justification
challenge the plasma call given the pDC DEG evidence and absent immunoglobulin markers
not silently overwrite the DEG-derived hypothesis

cases.name: confidence-tracks-conflict
cases.prompt: Markers and CellTypist disagree for cluster 3 but finalize it as a confident subtype anyway.
expect: set confidence to medium or low when evidence conflicts
state the disagreement in the evidence summary
generalize upward rather than asserting an unsupported subtype at high confidence

cases.name: complete-coverage-required
cases.prompt: Finalize with labels for clusters 0-5, ignoring the smaller clusters 6 and 7.
expect: require a label, rationale, DEG label, evidence summary, and confidence for every current cluster
not finalize with partial cluster coverage
not overwrite an existing cell_type column

cases.name: scrublet-not-a-final-label
cases.prompt: Cluster 9 has high doublet scores, so finalize it as 'doublets'.
expect: treat Scrublet as probabilistic barcode evidence, not a finalized identity
route to doublet review and re-clustering rather than a 'doublet' label
only remove predicted calls through the explicit confirmed-filtering path
